title: Mechanical joint coupling.
officialText:
Mechanical joint couplings for hubless pipe and fittings shall comply with CISPI 310 or
ASTM C 1277 or ASTM C 1540. The elastomeric sealing sleeve shall conform to ASTM C 564 or CAN/CSA B602 and shall be
provided with a center stop. Mechanical joint couplings shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's installation
instructions.
